fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The top-level error code, or 0 if there was no error

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The top-level error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member id is always generated by the streams consumer.

fields.name: MemberEpoch
fields.about: The member epoch.

fields.name: HeartbeatIntervalMs
fields.about: The heartbeat interval in milliseconds.

fields.name: AcceptableRecoveryLag
fields.about: The maximal lag a warm-up task can have to be considered caught-up.

fields.name: TaskOffsetIntervalMs
fields.about: The interval in which the task changelog offsets on a client are updated on the broker. The offsets are sent with the next heartbeat after this time has passed.

fields.name: Status
fields.about: Indicate zero or more status for the group.  Null if unchanged since last heartbeat.

fields.name: ActiveTasks
fields.about: Assigned active tasks for this client. Null if unchanged since last heartbeat.

fields.name: StandbyTasks
fields.about: Assigned standby tasks for this client. Null if unchanged since last heartbeat.

fields.name: WarmupTasks
fields.about: Assigned warm-up tasks for this client. Null if unchanged since last heartbeat.

fields.name: EndpointInformationEpoch
fields.about: The endpoint epoch set in the response

fields.name: PartitionsByUserEndpoint
fields.about: Global assignment information used for IQ. Null if unchanged since last heartbeat.

fields.name: UserEndpoint
fields.about: User-defined endpoint to connect to the node

fields.name: ActivePartitions
fields.about: All topic partitions materialized by active tasks on the node

fields.name: StandbyPartitions
fields.about: All topic partitions materialized by standby tasks on the node

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.about: A code to indicate that a particular status is active for the group membership

fields.name: StatusDetail
fields.about: A string representation of the status.

fields.name: Topic
fields.about: topic name

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: partitions

fields.name: SubtopologyId
fields.about: The subtopology identifier.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions of the input topics processed by this member.

fields.name: Host
fields.about: host of the endpoint

fields.name: Port
fields.about: port of the endpoint
